title: Ethium's Distinct Potions
description: A straightforward pack that retextures the potion items from Ethium Reimagined to look like they are from Shrimp's distinct potions
body:
![Before / After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/q7P8dQ59/images/6bf9f407f07b1f7287baa1904663198d44f03696.gif)

A straightforward pack that retextures the potion items from [Ethium Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/mod/ethium) to look like they are from [**Shrimp's Distinct Potions**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/shrimps-distinct-potions)

The purpose is mainly to make them look uniform if you are using _distinct potions_ alongside _Create: Ethium_
